Achin Gupta: 
Thank you, Diksha. Good afternoon to all of you, and we appreciate you joining our Q2 FY '27 
earnings call. We are pleased to report a revenue of INR7,404 crores with a steady sequential 
growth of 4% Q-o-Q. This was supported by a broad-based performance across our key 
businesses.  
One India recorded its highest ever quarterly revenue, while our global portfolio continued to 
demonstrate resilience amidst a dynamic operating environment. We continue to invest in 
pipeline, and we received key approvals, including our first DPI approval of generic Advair in 
the U.S.  
In line with our objective of strengthening Biosimilar pipeline, we partnered with Qilu for 
Pembrolizumab in North America, and we initiated clinical development for one more 
respiratory Biosimilar asset out of our own pipeline. Together, these developments reinforce our 
confidence in the long-term opportunities across our markets and portfolio. 
Coming to business-wise performance. One India delivered 12% Y-o-Y growth, sustaining its 
track record of consistent double-digit growth over the last few quarters, driven by strong 
execution across key therapies and the resilience of our franchise in the IPM. In our branded 
prescription business, we continue to outperform the market, delivering 15% growth, which was 
led by the chronic portfolio as per IQVIA YTD September '26. 
Our key chronic therapies continue to grow ahead of their respective markets with respiratory 
growing 11%; antidiabetes grew 50%, including the GLP; urology, 11%; and dermatology 16%. 
This was underpinned by strong brand equity, robust volume growth, effective field execution

and sustained momentum from new product introductions. Our overall chronic mix stood at 
60.3% as per IQVIA MAT September '26.

through targeted launches across key therapies, including Revesmart in respiratory, Galvus DM 
and SR in antidiabetes, Dytor E in cardiovascular and Rizontem in anti-infectives. These 
launches collectively underscore our focus on deepening our presence in priority therapy areas 
and further add to the breadth and competitiveness of our portfolio as we continue to lead IPM 
in terms of volume share. 
We also entered into an exclusive licensing agreement with CTTQ, SinoBiopharma Group, 
company for an asset -- novel asset, HER2 bispecific antibody drug conjugate. This partnership 
further strengthens our innovative oncology portfolio and expands our presence in the next-
generation targeted cancer therapies.  
On our trade generic business, delivered a strong double-digit Q-o-Q growth. Expanding the 
portfolio remains a key growth driver here with 15-plus new launches this quarter. On our 
Consumer Health business, we continued the upward trajectory with Nicotex, Omnigel and 
Cipladine consolidating their leadership positions in their segments.  
The business is driving healthy secondary growth and actively exploring opportunities to invest 
in products and channels to further expand the distribution. Operating profitability improved, 
reflecting the strength and scalability of our consumer health strategy. Coming to North 
America, we delivered a quarterly revenue of $172 million in Q2, which represents a $10 million 
improvement versus previous quarter.  
We remain confident of furthering this momentum through the remainder of this year, supported 
by our launch pipeline and scale up of these new assets. Cipla continues to hold the number one 
position in overall U.S. Albuterol MDI market this quarter as well with our market share of 22% 
as per IQVIA data for last week of September '26. 
So far this year, we have secured approvals for 2 key respiratory products with generic Ventolin 
approved in Q1 and generic Advair approved in Q2. Notably, generic Advair approval marked 
our first DPI approval from U.S.-based manufacturing network, further validating our 
differentiated respiratory capabilities and reinforcing our commitment to complex rescue 
therapies.  
Another important strategic milestone during the quarter was our exclusive partnership with Qilu 
Pharmaceutical for the U.S. commercialization of a biosimilar to Keytruda, Pembrolizumab. 
Looking ahead, we remain focused on enhancing the performance of our North America 
business through a combination of new product launches and disciplined commercial execution.  
A quick update on our pipeline. Our pipeline for this financial year includes 3 additional 
significant launches for the U.S., which is in line with our previous guidance. This includes two 
more respiratory assets and 1 key peptide opportunity. Additionally, we have four biosimilar 
programs under development for global markets, which continue to advance steadily through 
key development milestones.

quality and compliance across our network.
